title: Tour a compute platform
blurb: Thirteen 25 MW computers share one frame, and a black radiator wall 440 m away carries off their heat. Click any part.

title: Should data centers go to space?
blurb: In a sourced cost model, orbit costs 3.3 times the ground at 2026 prices. A calculator shows what launch, chip prices and a power cap do.

title: Fly the glider, the racer and the shuttle
blurb: Three vehicles on real physics, in the browser: a glider in a spinning city, a rocket on a fuel budget, a 155 t ship.

title: Race a rocket round the hull
blurb: No air, no grip, no top speed: every corner costs fuel. Watch the racer trailer, then fly the sprint yourself.

title: See who pays for Concordia
blurb: No trend line builds a two-billion-tonne city by 2045. What changed, who paid and what the station sells.

title: Try the hull-breach calculator
blurb: Hole a rotor wall and set the size. One square metre takes 27 days to lose 1 percent of the air.

title: Read why Concordia is safer than the 1970s designs
blurb: No windows, a shield that stands still, four sealed cities. What the 1970s cylinders got wrong and what changed.

title: Fly the glider
blurb: Take a small electric glider over the city and feel the same wing carry more weight with the spin than against it.

title: Follow the asteroid bag hauler
blurb: Metal-rich asteroids, bagged whole and hauled to L5. See where the station's first metal came from.
